item.title: Porch goals! Circa 1919 in Maryland. $389,000
item.description: Porch goals! What a great space that is! The house was built in 1919. It is located on .44 acre in Trappe, Maryland. The house features a large wrap around front porch, a screened in porch, wood floors, beautiful front door, nice staircase, baseboards, pocket doors, brick fireplace, vintage light fixtures and a spacious kitchen. There are a couple of detached storage buildings. Six bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,446 square feet. $389,000 Contact Donna Harrington with Coldwell Banker Realty: 443

item.title: Riverfront in Massachusetts! Big kitchen! Over one acre. $349,000
item.description: Riverfront in Massachusetts! The home is situated on the banks of the North Branch of the Hoosac River. The house was built in 1920. It is located on 1.6 acres in Clarksburg, Massachusetts. The house features a large covered front porch, spacious kitchen, wood floors, wainscoting and exposed beams. The backyard is fenced. There is a detached storage shed and a detached garage. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,335 square feet. $349,000 Contact Erin M. Smith with Burnham Gold Real Estate: 413-28

item.title: Doll in basement is odd! Secluded property. Almost five acres in Michigan. $275,000
item.description: The doll in the basement is a bit odd! This house looks very secluded. Perfect getaway spot! The house was built in 1900. It is located on 4.86 acres in Cedar, Michigan. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, exposed beams, exposed brick and knotty pine. The cabin needs work to be completed. There are a couple of outbuildings on the property. It is located on .42 acre in Aberdeen, Mississippi. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, crown moulding, wainscoting, baseboards, transom windows, picture rails, original mantels and built-in bookshelves. item.title: Don’t judge a book by its cover! Almost three acres in North Carolina. $314,900
item.description: Don’t judge a book by its cover! Huge workshop! The house was built in 1940. It is located on 2.89 acres in Albemarle, North Carolina. The house features a wrap around deck, wood floors, baseboards, updated kitchen, nice staircase and wainscoting. There is a large workshop on the property that has electricity, a woodstove and a concrete floor. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,012 square feet. $314,900 Contact Matthew Myers with Realty One Group Revolution: matthewmyersyourrealtor@gmail.com Fr

item.title: Beautiful area in the Virginia mountains! Two acres in Virginia. $299,900
item.description: Beautiful area in the Virginia mountains! The house was built in 1926. It is located on two acres in Glade Spring, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, wainscoting, bead board, chair rails, crown moulding, nice mantels, built-in china cabinet, solid wood doors with original hardware and a nice staircase. There are a few outbuildings on the property. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 2,303 square feet. $299,900 Contact Cynthia Routon with Holston Realty: 615-574-0773 Fro

item.title: Pretty details! Circa 1890 in Missouri. $229,000
item.description: This house has some pretty details! The house was built in 1890. It is located in Boonville, Missouri. The house features a small covered front porch, wood floors, nice staircase, wide baseboards, pretty windows, keyhole entryway, spacious kitchen and vintage light fixtures. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,350 square feet. $229,000 Contact Eddie Bernard Wiemholt with Chipley and Company Real Estate: 660-888-3853 From the Zillow listing: Victorian Charm in Boonville’s High Street Historic Dis

item.title: Pretty gardens! Circa 1910 in Montana. $393,250
item.description: This house has pretty gardens! There are fruit trees on the property! The house was built in 1910. It is located on .43 acre in Thompson Falls, Montana. The house features a wrap around front porch, a covered back porch, original wood floors, baseboards and a covered side porch. There are multiple gardens, berries and fruit trees. There is a chicken coop on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,408 square feet. $393,250 Contact Jared Andrew English with Congress Realty: 888-881-4118 F

item.title: Details!! Basement shuffleboard! Circa 1931 in Nebraska. $258,000
item.description: There is shuffleboard in the basement! This house has some amazing details! The house was built in 1931. It is located on .37 acre in Omaha, Nebraska. The house features a screened in front porch, arched front door, wood floors, wood flooring, crown moulding, brick fireplace, baseboards, arched entryway, original kitchen cabinets and a crystal chandelier.
